feeds.title: Nicole Perry Blog
feeds.description: As an educator and a scholar, my work is research on the intersections of bodies, power dynamics, consent-based practices, and creativity. Writing serves as a way to put words on my values, and to share them beyond the rooms I am in.

feeds.title: Philine Janssens Blog
feeds.description: With a solid background and years of experience as a performer, choreographer, and movement coach for actors, I realized some years ago that I was already working as an intimacy coordinator without knowing this job had a name.

feeds.title: Intimacy Coordination & Consultancy Blog
feeds.description: I am Rufai Ajala. I am a certified Intimacy Coordinator, having extensive knowledge of the best practices and ethics regulations when it comes to depicting intimacy on set. I have experience in crafting and safeguarding nuanced Intimate scenes and stories involving Queer Identity and Sexuality, Trans and Non-Binary Gender, Sexual Euphoria, and Sexual Traumatic scenes.

feeds.title: Intimacy on Set | Press
feeds.description: We provide services to TV, film, & theatre when dealing with intimacy, sexual content, and nudity. We work with producers all over the world (including HBO, Netflix, Warner Bros., and the BBC), have run workshops in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Sweden, Australia, and New Zealand, and are actively training a generation of Intimacy Coordinators.

feeds.title: Intimacy Directors and Coordinators Blog
feeds.description: IDC is the premier organization for consent and intimacy training in the entertainment industry. Our Mission is to equip every institution and individual artist in the entertainment industry with the resources and education needed to create a culture of consent in which intimate stories can be told with safety and artistry.
